definition: one of the parts that make up a whole
description: In a bright brick workshop with tall arched windows, a young man in a linen shirt and leather apron holds up one piece of amber glass with a number on it against the light and checks it. Then he lowers it and lays it carefully on its outline on a numbered paper pattern, next to a half-finished stained-glass panel of blue, green and orange pieces. A soldering iron, a coil of lead strip and a tin of nails lie on the bench, and a young woman behind him looks up and smiles.

de.answer: Er untersucht ein Stück bernsteinfarbenes Glas.
de.question: Was macht der Mann?

es.answer: Está examinando un trozo de vidrio ámbar.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo el hombre?

fr.answer: Il examine un morceau de verre ambré.
